name: Madring
layout: Madring Grand Prix circuit (IFEMA Madrid / Valdebebas, 2026)

sources.geometry: Hybrid: official F1 2026 circuit map (media.formula1.com 2026trackmadringdetailed.png) digitised and georeferenced by ICP (similarity transform, residual median 2.4 m / p90 5.5 m) to the OpenStreetMap Madring raceway ways (1366550177, 1366550176, 1366550171, 1366550168, 1366550166, 1378267450/452), then snapped to those OSM ways where within 12 m. Sections not in OSM (public-road/IFEMA parts, ~half the lap) follow the georeferenced official map only (estimated accuracy ~5-10 m).
sources.width: Published: 12 m everywhere, 15 m on the main straight and Turn 1 (Madring press material); La Monumental 12 m (Alpine F1 preview)
sources.elevation: IGN/CNIG MDT05 (PNOA LiDAR, 5 m, integer metres) via https://servicios.idee.es/wcs-inspire/mdt (Elevacion25830_5); predates circuit construction (built 2025-26); stations within 45 m of the M-11 (two new underpasses, Turns 5-6 and Turns 17-18) linearly interpolated to remove the motorway embankment; La Monumental embankment, new tunnels under the M-11 and re-grading are NOT in the data; heavy smoothing
sources.camber: Not measured (survey predates construction). Only La Monumental (Turn 12) has crossfall, from the published maximum banking of 24% (13.5 deg), clamped to the 20% format limit over the banked arc with ~60 m ramps; all other stations 0
sources.pit: OSM way 1552567031 "Madring pit lane" (entry near Turn 21-22, exit before Turn 1-3)
sources.trim: Semi-street layout, 22 turns plus long main and T3-T4 straights: medium-high downforce
sources.pitLimit: 80 km/h (2026 Spanish GP; Perez/Cadillac fined for exceeding the 80 km/h pit limit in FP1)
sources.pitLoss: About 24 s (2026 Spanish GP previews; Norris: "biggest pit loss of the year", longest pit lane); F1.com listed N/A
sources.raceLaps: 2026 Spanish GP (Madrid) 57 laps, not a sprint weekend

notes: Clockwise. Official length 5.414 km per F1.com/FIA 2026 (an earlier F1.com figure was 5.416 km; Madring originally announced 5.47 km). About half of the centreline is OSM raceway geometry, the rest is the georeferenced official F1 map. Elevation is pre-construction terrain (MDT05): treat the profile as approximate, especially at La Monumental and the M-11 underpasses. Turns 5A and 20A of the official map are not listed separately. Camber: only La Monumental, from the published 24% figure (clamped 20%), not measured.
